summary: Iteration 5 SwachhLens (auth + AI photo analysis + status flow) verified. All 14 pytest cases passed against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, including: staff invite-code enforcement (empty + wrong both 400), signup/login/me/logout, RBAC 403s for citizens on dashboard and PATCH, citizen-scoped GET /api/reports, staff sees-all, AI-powered image analysis (ai_powered=true with ai_summary confirmed on gemini-3-flash-preview), deterministic fallback without image, status_history append for Assigned/In Progress, resolve-without-evidence 400, resolve-with-evidence 200 + verified_at, and citizen->staff claim-staff upgrade. Full mobile UI flow (390x844) also passed: citizen signup, role toggle reveals/hides invite code, submit report -> AI success card, activity tab -> StatusTimeline, profile sheet with claim-staff, logout, staff signup with wrong code error then correct code, staff overview + hotspot map + priority queue + teams, urgent alert opens ReportDetail with assign/resolve controls.
action_items: Optional: pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope which requires setting EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in the pytest environment; consider inheriting it from frontend/.env in a conftest for future runs.
Cosmetic: a legacy DB report shows an unrecognized status label ('New') in the staff queue. Not created by this iteration's code path; safe to ignore or purge if desired.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext stores the bearer token client-side; server sessions are cleaned via 7-day TTL index (good).
server.py excludes _id from all Mongo reads (good).
ai_analyze_image degrades gracefully to deterministic_analysis on any exception, so a Gemini outage will not break report creation.
STATUS_FLOW enforcement on PATCH only guards Resolved (requires evidence). Non-linear transitions (e.g., jumping straight to In Progress) are allowed but harmless.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test accounts (test_citizen_<runtag>@swachhlens.test, test_staff_<runtag>@swachhlens.test) + several TEST_ reports and one UI-created citizen (ui_citizen_<ts>) and staff (ui_staff_<ts>). No delete endpoint exists; test data remains in DB, prefixed for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Run pytest with `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... pytest -n 0 /app/backend/tests/test_swachhlens_regression.py` (default addopts uses -n 2 --dist loadscope).
